metadata.title: Do a few early tokens decide the algorithm? (screen, Qwen3-8B)
deviations: closing-fence stop string (cuts post-code prose only)
HF cache = run's shared cache (system rule) instead of ./hf_cache
harness fails fast after the first timeout or 3 failed cases (passed is unaffected)
o_0 included as grid position 0 in CPD
baseline base paths screened on grid {4,8,16,32,64} only (fallback 5: baseline collapsed at R)
vLLM engine initialised with enforce_eager=True after the 0.92/0.95 memory settings failed (plan retry ladder step 3); throughput ~1,150 tok/s
swap: 20 continuations per cut under the ban prompt, 10 under the baseline prompt (reduction ladder step 3 applied to the baseline side only)
T2 Dial has no runtime signature (runtime unresolved -> AST fallback label)
S7 staged as 1 path per task x condition then the rest (plan: 1, 3, 10)
AST rules revised once after S6 (Bellman-Ford over adjacency lists; IDDFS loop-variable rule) and all labels recomputed

t6_sensitivity.note: 23 positions x S=8, planted change at a random position; 1000 permutations; tv=0 is the null FP rate

metadata.notes: screen estimates with intervals, not inferential tests; Wilson tuples are (p, lo, hi)
